answer.explanation: In the visible window every invocation of all four functions completes with an END and REPORT line. No timeouts, errors, throttling or out-of-memory conditions appear. CompressionFunction runs longer (about 480 to 730 ms) than the other functions, but its memory setting (1024 MB) matches ThumbnailerFunction, which runs in about 90 to 120 ms, so the memory configuration alone does not explain the gap. Its Max Memory Used stays at about 102 MB, so it is not memory-constrained, and the duration variance looks workload-driven. The window is truncated (4961 events omitted), so this conclusion is based on partial evidence and I did not have access to the timeout settings, IAM policies, IaC template or code history to confirm a configuration cause.
